thread:
maria.pm: Quick follow-up from the all-hands  a few PMs asked about the sequence for the reorg hires and how that affects roadmap commitments this quarter.

elena: Good question. The sequence is driven by impact to customer-facing SLOs and unblockers for Dedicated. We'll prioritize roles that directly reduce latency/cost for top customers.

sam.peopleops: Practical note: we split hiring into micro-waves so teams don't get multiple changes at once. Expect 3 micro-waves over the next 6 weeks.

ravi.eng: Can you confirm whether those waves will be regional? Our EMEA team is already understaffed.

elena: Regional allocation is part of prioritization. EMEA and US critical-path teams can get seats in the first micro-wave if product justification is provided.

maria.pm: If a manager wants to reallocate an approved headcount to another team, what's the approval path?

sam.peopleops: Submit the "headcount reallocation" form, manager + org lead sign-off required. Finance will triage for runway risk. Expect 48-72h response.

kai.recruiter: We'll tag all priority reqs in Greenhouse with the label PRIORITY_MICROWAVE so hiring teams can filter. Internal mobility is run in parallel  internal candidates skip the recruiter screen if they apply within 5 business days.

maria.pm: Any change to leveling or comp calibration for transfers?

sam.peopleops: Level stays with the role. Transfers go through a short calibration panel to ensure consistent leveling; compensation adjustments handled case-by-case.

ravi.eng: For managers who are stretched thin, is there a plan to hire ICs first so managers can focus on transition work?

elena: Yes  where operational risk is high we will prioritize IC hires ahead of manager moves. Where leadership gaps would block multiple teams, we'll prioritize manager hires and provide a 2-4 week overlap budget.

orgchart-bot: "Org map draft published: https://intra.redwood/org/drafts (view-only). New reporting lines highlighted in orange."

maria.pm: Super helpful  thanks. We'll review the draft and flag any cross-team dependencies.

sam.peopleops: We're also scheduling a leveling clinic and a hiring Q&A drop-in next Tuesday 10am PT. Invite in #all-hands calendar.

elena: Appreciate the questions. If anyone has immediate capacity risks, DM Sam + your director and we'll reprioritize the micro-wave slots.
